# Grading Rules Checklist: M9 Credits, Rule Sets, Marks, GPA

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of rules R33–R41 and tests T36–T43 (`docs/spec.md`
§13.3, §13.5) as captured in spec.md, plan.md, research.md, data-model.md, and contracts/.
**Created**: 2026-10-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Scope: R33–R41 and T36–T43 only. Depth: standard. Audience: reviewer before implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the seeded defaults (two rule sets, seven components, six bands per attendance component, ten grade rows) fully enumerated with every column value, including position order and which component is final? [Completeness, Spec §13.3 Seeds, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it specified which component values are stored for each kind (item fields for `items`, bands for `attendance`) and what happens to values supplied for the other kind? [Completeness, Spec §13.3 R34, research D3]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all R34 validation cases listed as distinct, checkable conditions (name, weight sum tolerance, attendance count, final count and kind, best/item counts, band presence and 0 band)? [Completeness, Spec §13.3 R34, contracts/core-api.md]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the behavior defined for removing a component whose linked assessments have no score, given that the foreign key has no delete action? [Gap, Spec §13.3 R34, research D3]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the error kind and condition defined for deleting a rule set that a course uses, including archived courses and courses in other terms? [Completeness, Spec §13.3 R34, research D5]
- [ ] CHK006 Are all inputs of the R38 formula defined (total, non-final secured, final marks, final item_max) including the case where the final's item_max is NULL? [Completeness, Spec §13.3 R38]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the four new backup arrays, their row fields, and their ordering defined so that export → restore → export can be byte-equal except `exported_at`? [Completeness, Spec §13.3 R41, contracts/core-backup.md]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the version-1 restore outcome defined for every new column and table (courses ungraded, assessments unlinked and unscored, four tables equal to seeds)? [Completeness, Spec §13.3 R41]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is "missing items" in R38 defined precisely enough to decide whether 3 of 4 entered quizzes with best 3 counts as one missing item? [Ambiguity, Spec §13.3 R38, T39, research OQ-1]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "fully assessed" in R40 defined in terms of R35/R36 quantities (assessed fraction vs items entered) without ambiguity? [Ambiguity, Spec §13.3 R40, research OQ-1]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the rounding method for each rounded value stated (projected pct 1 decimal, needed score rounded up to 1 decimal, GPA 2 decimals), including tie handling? [Clarity, Spec §13.3 R37/R38/R40, research D7]
- [ ] CHK012 Is it clear that the letter lookup uses the projected pct after rounding to 1 decimal, so that 79.95 maps to A+? [Clarity, Spec §13.3 R37, T40]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "the final already has a score" defined (any linked scored assessment) and is "show the actual grade" tied to a specific value (the R37 letter)? [Clarity, Spec §13.3 R38, research D10]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the band selection rule ("highest min_pct ≤ pct") unambiguous at exact boundaries such as 85.0 and 90.0? [Clarity, Spec §13.3 R35]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the meaning of item_max NULL ("the component's marks for that course") stated consistently wherever item_max is used (R36 earned fraction, R36 score check, R38 needed score, UI "x / max")? [Clarity, Spec §13.3 R36/R38, data-model.md]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK016 Do the R36 assessed fraction (capped at K) and the R38 assumption list (missing items) use compatible definitions, or is the difference documented? [Consistency, Spec §13.3 R36/R38, research OQ-1]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the set of courses included in R40 (non-archived, graded, active term, projected pct) consistent with the "left out for lack of marks" count? [Consistency, Spec §13.3 R40]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the R33 "not graded" conditions (missing credits or rule set) applied consistently across course marks, needed in final, and GPA? [Consistency, Spec §13.3 R33]
- [ ] CHK019 Is R41's `schema_version` 2 consistent with the R25 refusal of newer databases and the R22 rejection of newer backups, and are existing version pins identified for update? [Consistency, Spec §4 R22/R25, research D14]
- [ ] CHK020 Are the seeded weights consistent with the R34 sum-to-100 rule (Theory 10+15+25+50, Lab 30+40+30)? [Consistency, Spec §13.3 Seeds/R34]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK021 Does each T36 case (weights 95, two finals, best 5 of 4, no 0 band) map to exactly one R34 condition so a failure is attributable? [Measurability, Spec §13.5 T36]
- [ ] CHK022 Are T37 and T38 expected values derivable from R33/R35/R36 alone (39.0 of 45; 27.0 of 30)? [Measurability, Spec §13.5 T37/T38, research arithmetic check]
- [ ] CHK023 Are the T39 inputs complete enough to reproduce 111.0 and 96.0 (credits, rule set, attendance pct, each score with its max, final unscored)? [Measurability, Spec §13.5 T39]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the T39 "a quiz missing" variant specified with concrete inputs and an expected assumption entry? [Gap, Spec §13.5 T39]
- [ ] CHK025 Does T41 specify enough to build courses that project exactly A+ and B, and the "projected" status? [Measurability, Spec §13.5 T41, research arithmetic check]
- [ ] CHK026 Is "equal except `exported_at`" in T42 defined at the JSON-text level or the parsed-value level? [Clarity, Spec §13.5 T42]
- [ ] CHK027 Does T43 define which item_max the "score above item_max" case uses (explicit 15 or NULL → component marks)? [Clarity, Spec §13.5 T43]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements defined for an items component with more linked scores than item_count? [Edge Case, Gap, research D9]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements defined for an attendance component when R13 pct is None in the needed-in-final calculation? [Edge Case, Spec §13.3 R35/R38, research D8]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the behavior defined when nothing in a course is assessed (projected pct None, no letter, needed table still shown)? [Edge Case, Spec §13.3 R37/R38]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the behavior defined when an assessment is linked to a component outside the course's current rule set, or when the course's rule set or credits change after scores exist? [Gap, research OQ-2]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the behavior defined for `term_gpa` when there is no active term? [Edge Case, Spec §13.3 R40, research D12]
- [ ] CHK033 Are fractional credits (1.5) covered in total marks, component marks, and GPA weighting? [Coverage, Spec §13.3 R33/R40, T41]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the migration 002 upgrade path of an existing version-1 database (data kept, seeds added, R26 copy written) covered by a requirement and a test? [Coverage, Spec §13.1 R26, §13.3]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK035 Is the dependency of R35 on the R13 percentage (attended / (attended + absent), 1 decimal) stated, including that cancelled and pending sessions do not count? [Dependency, Spec §4 R13, §13.3 R35]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the assumption that CSV formats stay unchanged recorded with a test or explicit statement? [Assumption, Spec §13.3 R41]
- [ ] CHK037 Are the open questions OQ-1 and OQ-2 recorded with options and a recommendation, and are the tasks they affect identified? [Traceability, research.md]
